title: Local Climate Zones (LCZ), 17 classes
publisher: Stewart and Oke (2012) typology; global LCZ map by Demuzere et al. (Ruhr-University Bochum, WUDAPT)
version: Global map of Local Climate Zones, Zenodo version 3.0.0 (2023-10-08), nominal year 2018
license_note: Class names and colours are the 'official hex color' table of the readme of the global LCZ map v3.0.0 (Demuzere et al., Zenodo), also embedded in lcz_filter_v3.tif. Typology: Stewart, I. D. and Oke, T. R. (2012), Bull. Amer. Meteor. Soc. 93(12), 1879-1900, doi:10.1175/BAMS-D-11-00019.1.
note: Built types 1-10 describe urban form, not use: they are drawn as the nearest land-use element (compact, open, lightweight and sparsely built -> residential_area, consistent with urban fabric in clc and urban_atlas; large low-rise and heavy industry -> commercial_area). The dataset authors advise combining the built classes with a land-cover product. Land-cover types A-G are listed twice: by letter and by their raster value 11-17 (same colours). Colours are palette A, declared official by the dataset authors. A slightly different palette B (Earth Engine Data Catalog entry RUB/RUBCLIM/LCZ/global_lcz_map/latest, often quoted as 'the WUDAPT colours') circulates; it is not included here because it was only seen on a catalogue page. Labels written as 'LCZ 2' or 'LCZ A' must be reduced to 2 or A before lookup.
